To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Credit constraints are the major barriers to the adoption of climate adaptation strategies.

(i) credit constrained smallholder farmers in South West of Nigeria are less likely to adapt to climate change; (ii) age of the household head, source of credit and distance to the sources of credit, interest rates, access to extension, and access to climate information are the key determinants of credit constraints amongst smallholder farmers in Nigeria.

the adoption of climate adaptation strategies is constrained by lack of access to credit, and the determinants of access to credit are the age of the household head, the source of credit and the interest rate.
